(Maybe this time without being warned) - Reth, Erigon, Nimbus EL support it - Nethermind supports it for period of 1 year; next release should allow a shorter period - Besu broken since `26.2.0`. They know and are working on a fix. Support is experimental behind an `-X` flag - Ethrex has an active PR, I expect it in a release Soon(tm) - Geth has a PR that sina opened and lightclient commented on. Maybe lightclient can say whether this can make it into Geth by Glamsterdam I love the idea of amending EIP-4444 if nothing else, it's the brand by which it's known and otherwise people will keep looking up 4444 and seeing stale numbers Reth doesn't have it 33_024 epochs by default no? Not by default. It's supported. `--prune.bodies.distance 1056768 --prune.receipts.distance 1056768` plus whatever other prune settings. Their default is an archive node DB ends up being around 400 GiB with that My full prune settings for an expired Reth are `--block-interval 5 --prune.senderrecovery.full --prune.accounthistory.distance 10064 --prune.storagehistory.distance 10064 --prune.transactionlookup.distance 10064 --prune.bodies.distance 1056768 --prune.receipts.distance 1056768` Thats smaller than I was expecting; tbc the total storage for reth node is 400GB? 400 GiB not GB, and yes that's total. Last tested recently. My records of DB size by clients, keeping in mind these data are outdated rapidly: <https://ethdocker.com/Usage/ResourceUsage#disk-and-ram-requirements> 400 GiB is around 430 GB Manufacturers sell storage in GB (power of 10) and an OS counts GiB (2**10 based) very useful link, thank you 🙂 I wouldn't use a 1TB drive, particularly with blobs and state growth; but 2TB is completely feasible with rolling history expiry That's roughly 1.8 TiB, plenty of space even for a supernode

excerpts.author: yorickdowne
excerpts.content:
Because it came up in ACDE 244, current status of rolling history expiry for `33_024` epochs. (Maybe this time without being warned)
- Reth, Erigon, Nimbus EL support it
- Nethermind supports it for period of 1 year; next release should allow a shorter period
- Besu broken since `26.2.0`. They know and are working on a fix. Support is experimental behind an `-X` flag
- Ethrex has an active PR, I expect it in a release Soon(tm)
- Geth has a PR that sina opened and lightclient commented on. Maybe lightclient can say whether this can make it into Geth by Glamsterdam

excerpts.author: yorickdowne
excerpts.content: I love the idea of amending EIP-4444

excerpts.author: tersec
excerpts.content: if nothing else, it's the brand by which it's known and otherwise people will keep looking up 4444 and seeing stale numbers

excerpts.content: Not by default. It's supported. `--prune.bodies.distance 1056768 --prune.receipts.distance 1056768` plus whatever other prune settings. Their default is an archive node
